$jsonSchema.description: The logs for each user of everything they ate

version.description: tracks which version of this collection this document is from

user_id.description: connects the log to a specific user

days.description: a dict of all meals the user has ever logged, keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD)

^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$.description: Contains all meals eaten by a user for that day

totals.description: the total macros for this day

carb.description: the amount of carbohydrates (milligrams) the user consumed for this day

protein.description: the amount of protein (milligrams) the user consumed for this day

calorie.description: the number of calories (in tenths of a calorie) the user consumed for this day

fat.description: the amount of fat (milligrams) the user consumed for this day

meals.description: all meals logged within a given day

menu_item_id.description: links each meal in a meal log to a specific menu item in Menu_Items

servings.description: the number of servings the user had for this meal

food_id.description: the id of the food eaten in Foods

log_ts.description: the date and time this meal was logged
